# railway_service (Data Source)

Railway service. Look it up by `id`, or by `project_id` and `name`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "railway_service" "api" {
  project_id     = railway_project.example.id
  name           = "api"
  environment_id = data.railway_environment.production.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `environment_id` (String) Identifier of the environment the instance settings are read from. **Default** is the project's default environment.
- `id` (String) Identifier of the service. Conflicts with `name`.
- `name` (String) Name of the service. Requires `project_id`.
- `project_id` (String) Identifier of the project the service belongs to.

### Read-Only

- `config_path` (String) Path to the Railway config file.
- `cron_schedule` (String) Cron schedule of the service.
- `root_directory` (String) Root directory of the service.
- `source_image` (String) Source image of the service.
- `source_repo` (String) Source repository of the service.
